answers.core: I have doubts on this being something necessary to core, but it doesn't sound as if it would be difficult to simply expose access to the scroll range property of the PopupMenu unless my ignorance of C++ is blinding me to the difficulty this poses.
answers.workaround: To implement this myself, I would have to entirely re-implement my own OptionButton from the ground up repeating all of the code necessary to add items, define their metadata, handling the styleboxes, the theme, literally the entire code of the OptionButton / PopupMenu re-written in GDScript just for the scrollbar range property.

title: Expose the internal ScrollContainer inside PopupMenu
